hazard_description: Observed continuous fluid mist and audible hissing from the 4-inch API Spec 16D choke manifold buffer flange operating under 4,800 PSI. Handheld multi-gas meter registered 16.2 ppm H2S in the immediate breathing zone. Tour pusher attempted to hot-torque flange bolts with sledge wrench while line was pressurized to 4,800 PSI.
immediate_actions_taken: Motorman verbally invoked Stop Work Authority on rig floor.
Ordered personnel back 50 feet away from the pressurized line.
